title: Delete is disabled while a part still uses the Part Library entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELOFF-01) has one inventory part behind it, at {Location-A} ("Total parts" 1).
  • That inventory part is on no work order and has no open return or credit.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Look at the bottom left of the window.
  6. Hover over the Delete button.
  7. Click the Delete button.
  8. Click Cancel.
  9. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  10. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  11. Click the {Part-A} row.
  12. Click Delete Part.
  13. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  14. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  15. Click the {Part-A} row.
  16. Click the pencil icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  17. Hover over the Delete button.
  18. Do not click Delete.
  19. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The "Edit Library Part" window opens.
  • Step 5: A Delete button sits at the bottom left of the window, dimmed (disabled).
  • Step 6: Hovering it shows "Part cannot be deleted. Please delete related parts first."
  • Step 7: Nothing happens: no "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?" question opens, and the entry is not deleted.
  • Step 15: The detail page shows "Total parts" 0: no part uses the entry any more.
  • Step 17: The Delete button is now enabled, and hovering it shows no hover text.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); story SV-10825 (Story 12, Call the Shared Parts List the Part Library); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-R3c, S11-R3, S12-R13, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 12); QA lead's 9 Oct set-up answer 4. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
